title: Bind Dynamic PVC & Mount in Deployment
prompt:
Workload `cache` in namespace `cka-sc` requires dynamically provisioned persistent storage.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Create PersistentVolumeClaim `cache-pvc` in namespace `cka-sc` requesting `200Mi`, `ReadWriteOnce`, using StorageClass `local-path`.
2. Create Deployment `cache` (`1` replica, `image: nginx:1.27-alpine`, container `web`) mounting `cache-pvc` at `/data`.
hints: In WaitForFirstConsumer StorageClasses like `local-path`, the PVC binds once a Pod consuming it is scheduled.
Check PVC status (`k -n cka-sc get pvc`) after creating Deployment `cache`.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: cache-pvc
  namespace: cka-sc
spec:
  storageClassName: local-path
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 200Mi
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cache
  namespace: cka-sc
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: cache
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: cache
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        volumeMounts:
        - name: vol
          mountPath: /data
      volumes:
      - name: vol
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: cache-pvc

reference_solution: Create `cache-pvc` using `storageClassName: local-path` and mount it at `/data` inside Deployment `cache`.
